title: Helios Entra Graph Credentials
description: Managed-preferences payload holding the Microsoft Entra (Graph) app-only credentials used by Helios Console for device cleanup during the Return to Service action. Deploy this under a dedicated preference domain (bundle identifier) of your choosing, then point Helios at it via the console profile's entra.credentialDomain key. Helios is not sandboxed and reads this domain via UserDefaults(suiteName:) / CFPreferences. WARNING: managed-preference plists are world-readable on the Mac (/Library/Managed Preferences/<domain>.plist); scope this domain tightly and prefer certificate auth over a client secret. The app registration must hold the Device.ReadWrite.All application permission AND be assigned the 'Cloud Device Administrator' Entra role — without the role, Graph returns 403 on device delete.

entra_tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID). Helios also accepts the key spellings: tenantID, tenant_id, TenantID, entra_tenant.

entra_client_id.description: Entra app registration (client) ID (GUID). Helios also accepts: clientID, client_id, ClientID, entra_client.

entra_cert_pem.description: PEM containing the certificate followed by its RSA private key (BEGIN CERTIFICATE … + BEGIN PRIVATE KEY / BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY …). Preferred auth: Helios signs a PS256 client assertion (JWT) with this key and presents the certificate thumbprint (x5t#S256). Used in preference to entra_client_secret whenever present. Encrypted private keys are not supported. Helios also accepts the key spellings: entra_certificate, cert_pem, certPEM, entra_cert, certificate_pem. Note: this must be the PEM string itself, not a file path — Helios runs in user context and cannot read a root-owned PEM file.

entra_client_secret.description: Entra app client secret. Fallback auth, used only when entra_cert_pem is absent. Helios also accepts: clientSecret, client_secret, ClientSecret.
